summary: QubeYards real estate platform with buy/sell/rent listings, admin-controlled property approvals, news/magazine section, channel partner system with currency rewards for referrals
architectural_notes: Admin role with exclusive property approval/edit permissions required
Currency/rewards system for partner referrals and listings
Role-based access control: public users, channel partners, admin
imageRequirements:
## Required Images
- QubeYards company logo with modern real estate aesthetic in teal and gold colors (qubeyards-logo.dim_200x80.png)
- Luxury real estate hero banner showing premium property with modern architecture (hero-luxury.dim_1920x600.png)
- News and magazine section header image with real estate theme (news-header.dim_1200x400.png)
- QubeYards currency coin icon in gold with company branding (currency-icon.dim_128x128.png)

existing_features.title: Create a partner registration system where channel partners can sign up with their name, company name, contact details, and license information
Implement a property listing dashboard where partners can view available real estate properties with details like location, price, type, and status
Create a lead management system where partners can add, track, and manage customer leads with status tracking
Build a commission tracking feature that shows partners their earned commissions, pending amounts, and payment history
Implement partner authentication using Internet Identity so partners can securely log in and access their personalized dashboard

Create a visually appealing, professional interface with a modern real estate industry aesthetic featuring warm earth tones, clean layouts, and property-focused imagery that conveys trust and professionalism
Display generated hero banner and property placeholder images as static assets from frontend/public/assets/generated
Add pan-India location support by updating property location field to accept any Indian city/state and display pan-India coverage in the UI
Create an offers display section on the main dashboard showing a single prominent offer line that highlights current deals or promotions
Add project stage categorization (pre-launch, launch, ready-to-shift) to property data model and implement filtering by project stage in the property listing interface
Add property approval workflow where new property listings require admin approval before becoming visible to all users, with pending status for unapproved properties
Create a news and magazine section accessible from main navigation that displays real estate news articles, industry updates, and magazine-style content
Display QubeYards currency balance prominently in the partner's dashboard and profile, showing total earned currency and recent currency transactions

Restrict channel partner features (QubeYards Partner section) so that only authenticated users with partner role can access partner-specific functionality like property listing submission and currency tracking
Update branding throughout the application to use QubeYards name, logo, and identity consistently across all pages, navigation, and communications

Create a modern, premium visual design system for QubeYards with a sophisticated color palette featuring deep teals, golds, and whites that conveys luxury real estate brand positioning with clean typography and professional property imagery

new_feature_requests.summary: Implement buy, sell, rent property transaction types with pan-India coverage
Add offers display section on main interface
Create property categorization: pre-launch, launch, ready-to-shift projects
Implement admin-only approval and edit system for property listings
Add news/magazine section for real estate content
Create channel partner (QubeYards Partner) section accessible only to partners
Implement QubeYards currency reward system for property listings and referrals displayed in partner ID
Add transaction type field (buy, sell, rent) to property data model in backend and update all property-related functions to support this field
Implement admin role system in backend with functions to designate admin users and restrict property approval and edit operations to admin role only
Implement QubeYards currency reward system in backend that tracks and awards currency points to partners when they list properties or provide referrals
